title: Reactor theorized as a cyclotron hitting element 115

tellings.quote: So, it was theorized apparently Barry with his other lab partner, they thought that was a cyclotron, an accelerator.

plain: Sometime between 1987 and 1989, scientists at S4, a secret site in Nevada, guessed that the power source in a recovered craft was a cyclotron, a machine that speeds up particles, firing at element 115, a very heavy chemical element. Bob Lazar, a physicist who says he worked at S4 on craft not made by humans, tells it from what a colleague named Barry Castilio told him: "it was theorized apparently Barry with his other lab partner, they thought that was a cyclotron, an accelerator." If true, it would mean the team was trying to work out how a craft from somewhere else was powered.
